paragraphs.heading: 떡밥과 수수께끼

paragraphs.quote: After the quest she can be found at Café Lutece, where she can be interacted with once before running off and never showing up again.

sentences.t_raw: Chronie는 관련 퀘스트를 마친 뒤 Café Lutece에서 발견할 수 있다.
